method: Native Godot skeletal playback at 120 samples/s with half-sample offset; exact original CPU-skinned boot and blade vertices; real rendered pose sheets.
checks_qualification: Count includes repeated finite/normalized assertions on each bone at each sample, not 90,647 distinct gameplay scenarios.
visual_review: Viewed each of the six actual native four-pose sheets. Accepted natural anatomical silhouettes and readable movement.
Jump and landing show deliberate knee compression/tuck. Sprint has distinct forward lean and alternating flight; grip remains in the hand.
Existing tunic skinning stretches across deeply flexed legs, especially crouch/jump. No cloth simulation or mesh re-authoring is claimed.
limits: This is animation-asset acceptance. Controller transitions, terrain, collision, multiplayer timing and action interruption require the separate integrated controller suite.
Captured sheets are native engine frames, not image-generation concepts.
No additional character models, armor rigs, motion capture, or new authored directional/cleave clips are claimed.
